purpose: Inventory of external raw inputs required for the published housing and office analyses. Raw datasets are intentionally excluded.
path_base: Each input path is relative to its study directory under the public package root.
snapshot_hash_note: SHA256 values identify the original local input snapshots. Revised inputs can change analysis outputs.
acquisition_note: Source URLs are recorded only where preserved in the local source files. An empty URL list marks a provenance gap, not an unavailable dataset. Obtain missing downloads from the named agency and preserve the schema. Several tidy CSVs require manual normalization because their construction scripts were not preserved.
validation_note: check_inputs.py verifies file presence and reports snapshot hash changes. It does not validate CSV schemas, workbook layouts, data quality, or research results.
